familiar.helloLoveMonthly: The moon's tides for this month have only just settled in my heart... Somewhere mid-month there's a small ripple of feeling, but just past that bend hides a lovely surprise for you two. Shall I whisper the tender highlights of this moonlight to you first?
familiar.helloLoveYearly: I walked all 365 days of your star path for you... The year gathers your bond so warmly — only the third season holds a crossroads of reality, and I'd love to help you carry an umbrella early. Which season shall we begin with, nice and slow?
familiar.helloWealthCore: I quietly peeked into your innate treasury... your wealth star sits strong and the promise is grand — a true hidden golden vault. That breakthrough point is tucked into the fine details of your chart. Shall I point it out to you first?
familiar.helloWealthMonthly: This month's wealth reading has just come to a close... mind the loss star in the last ten days, though the steady income early on flows warm. Shall I gently walk you through this month's rhythm of gain?
familiar.helloWealthYearly: I've spread out your entire year's wealth map... The rise and fall across the four seasons is clear, and mid-year glows with one rare breakthrough. Shall we unfold it season by season, nice and slow?
familiar.helloDaily: A new day, and the stars have turned for you again! Today I sense your lucky color is [{{color}}], and your lucky number is [{{num}}]. Stay at ease — which aspect of the stars shall we explore first today?
